## Scope and record conventions

This wiki compiles supplied records dated November 2024–September 2026, plus undated notes. Source IDs identify provenance. Contract drafting, execution and effective dates are kept distinct; an executed future amendment is not treated as already effective. Drafts, customer redlines, meeting recollections, CRM entries and signed instruments retain their own status and context. Unnamed authors and ambiguous shorthand remain unidentified where the sources do not establish identity.

## Company, product and entity directory

**Pemberline Systems** supplies **Pemberline Dock**, yard and dock scheduling software. Described modules include dispatcher console, gatehouse kiosk, carrier self-scheduling, yard spotter tasks, trailer tracking and APIs. [D024][D027][D028]

#### MSA legal and service detail

- Named users, no generic shared credentials; reassignment for termination, operational transfer or leave **over 14 days**. Additions minimum **five**, prorated discounted rate; no reduction below 140 during active period. Access is nonexclusive, nontransferable except assignment provisions, nonsublicensable; no IP sale. [D028]
- Annual invoices effective date / subsequent periods at least **30 days** ahead; additions at provisioning. USD ACH/wire, customer pays originating wire fees. Disputes within **20 calendar days**, resolve in **15 business days**, undisputed balances paid Net 45. Interest **1.5% monthly** or legal maximum from day **46**. Unpaid **15 days after Net 45** permits delinquency notice; suspension after another **10 business days** without payment. PO boilerplate rejected. [D028]
- Tier 2 permits up to **six** designated administrators. Sev 1 **24×7×365**, human response **30 minutes**, hourly updates / continuous engineering; Sev 2 Monday–Saturday **05:00–23:00 CT**, response **2 hours**, updates **4 hours**; Sev 3 Monday–Friday **07:00–19:00 CT**, excluding federal holidays, **8 business hours**; Sev 4 Monday–Friday **08:00–17:00 CT**, **2 business days**. [D028]
- Uptime **99.5% monthly**. Exclusions: scheduled Saturday **23:00–Sunday 03:00 CT** with **48-hour** notice, force majeure, local hardware/networks/ISPs, third-party TMS/WMS, contractual suspension. Credits against **$18,993.33** monthly equivalent: **5%** at **99.00–99.49%**, **10%** at **98.00–98.99%**, **20%** below **98%**; written claim within **30 days** after month end. Sole financial SLA remedy; below **97% for three consecutive months** may be material breach. [D028]
- Customer owns data; hosting/processing license limited to service, maintenance, security, troubleshooting and configured carrier bookings. Customer responsible for legality, accuracy and consent. Prohibited uploads include PCI, Social Security numbers, driver-license photos, medical certifications and regulated hazmat security plans, except necessary standard UN/NA **four-digit** placarding codes. Deidentified telemetry cannot identify customer, user, terminal, shipping customer or driver or reveal customer data. [D028]
- CSV/JSON export; after termination **30-day** read-only retrieval, active deletion within subsequent **15 days**, backups within **90 days**. TLS **1.2+**, AES-**256**, tenant isolation, SAML **2.0** SSO/MFA and RBAC. Annual SOC 2 Type II examination; report and penetration-test summary on request at most annually. Confirmed security incident involving unencrypted data: notification within **48 hours**. Continental-US redundant zones; RPO **15 minutes**, RTO **4 hours**, annual DR testing. [D028]
- Confidentiality includes pricing, 12% discount, customer terminal/volume/rate data. Standard public/prior-known/third-party/independent-development exclusions, need-to-know access, compelled-disclosure assistance and equitable relief. Pemberline retains platform IP; customer marks only for branded portal, public use needs per-instance written consent; feedback license perpetual, royalty-free, excluding customer confidential/data content. [D028]
- Restrictions include resale, reverse engineering, competitive benchmarking, unannounced testing, seat-limit bypass, malicious/unlawful content. Customer maintains local hardware/connectivity. Express performance/no-material-diminution/malware warranties; **30-day** correction then termination/pro-rata unused-prepaid refund for material failure. No warranty of uninterrupted operation or prevention of yard accidents/detention. [D028]
- Provider defends US/Canadian IP claims; procure rights, equivalent replacement or **30-day** termination/refund if impracticable. Exclusions for unauthorized modification, unsupported combinations, continued superseded configuration and customer data/rules. Customer indemnifies data/marks/privacy claims and physical yard injury/property damage except provider gross negligence/willful misconduct. Defense control and release conditions apply. [D028]
- Consequential damages, lost profits, detention/demurrage and supply-chain delays excluded. General cap preceding **12 months’** fees, initial **$227,920**; confidentiality/security super-cap **2×**, initial **$455,840**. Indemnity, undisputed fees, license restrictions, gross negligence, willful misconduct/fraud excluded from caps. Section **13.2 cross-references 13.3/13.4 labels in reverse** relative to their headings; retained as document inconsistency. [D028]
- Insurance minimum carrier **A- VII**: CGL **$1m occurrence / $2m aggregate**; technology E&O/cyber **$5m claim/aggregate**; statutory workers’ compensation and employers’ liability **$1m**; umbrella **$3m**. Certificates on request; **30-day** cancellation/material-reduction notice. Emergency suspension limited to necessary seats/endpoints, notify Thea within **2 hours**, restore promptly. [D028]
- Automatic successive **12-month** periods; written noncontinuation at least **120 calendar days** before period close. Material-breach cure **30 days**; insolvency proceeding not dismissed within **60 days** permits termination. Data, confidentiality, IP, liability, indemnity and specified administrative obligations survive. Assignment generally consent-based, with qualifying affiliate/M&A exception and written notice/assumption; customer assignee cannot be direct software competitor. Pemberline remains responsible for subprocessors and Stoneharrow. [D028]
- Notices: personal delivery; courier second business day; email first business day with signed PDF/no bounce; Articles 12/16 also physical courier within **24 hours**. Pemberline `legal-notices@pemberline.example`; QFL `tramaswell@quarrendonfreight.example` / `legal@quarrendonfreight.example`, Thea plus General Counsel. Illinois law, Cook County courts, jury waiver, CISG/UCITA excluded; force majeure excludes money owed; independent contractors, export/anti-corruption compliance, severability, written signed amendments and electronic counterparts. [D028]
